intro: Fink Advisory Group claims the analysis is handled by AI models, so newcomers can follow signals instead of charts. The claim is easy to publish. The verification is what this review looks for.
The offer is a dashboard, a set of AI signals, and a broker relationship. You fund US$250, set risk preferences, and trade 12 assets automatically or by hand, with the demo alongside.
The scorecard reflects what the platform publishes, not what its ads promise. We checked the claims against the pages, looked for independent verification, and marked the gaps we found.

Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
Signals generated without manual chart reading.

whatWeChecked: The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.

faqs.q: Does it offer a demo account?
faqs.a: Yes - a practice account is part of the package and runs alongside the live balance, which is the sensible first step before risking the US$250 minimum.

faqs.q: Is it really fee-free?
faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

bottomLine: What we found is a real service wrapped in marketing that outruns its own fine print. Trade the service, not the marketing.
4.5 is our number, and it means the product works with conditions attached. The demo costs nothing; use it while the claims remain unproven.
